title: Prediction certification cannot replace explanation certification: a competence envelope for trustworthy AI under compound stress
abstract: arXiv:2608.20825v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Artificial intelligence systems increasingly make consequential judgments - which patient is deteriorating, which building is safe to enter, whether an image is authentic and are trusted on the strength of how accurately and confidently they predict. The safeguards that certify them are correspondingly prediction-based: accuracy, calibration and conformal coverage all measure how well a model performs. Whether such checks are sufficient to establish model trustworthiness has remained unclear. Here we prove that they cannot. We establish a separation theorem showing that a reliable model and a compromised one can be identical under every prediction-side certificate, including accuracy, calibration and coverage, yet differ arbitrarily in explanation fidelity and deployment behaviour. translated_title: 预测认证无法替代解释认证：复合压力下可信AI的能力包络
translated_abstract: 人工智能系统越来越多地做出关键判断——哪个患者病情恶化、哪栋建筑可以安全进入、图像是否真实，并且其可信度依赖于它们预测的准确性和置信度。相应的认证保障也基于预测：准确性、校准和共形覆盖率都衡量模型表现如何。这些检查是否足以确立模型可信度仍不清楚。在此，我们证明它们不能。我们建立了一个分离定理，表明一个可靠模型和一个受损模型在每一项预测侧认证（包括准确性、校准和覆盖率）下可以完全相同，但在解释保真度和部署行为上却任意不同。检测这种失败需要访问模型的决策机制，而不仅仅是其预测。我们引入了能力包络作为一种操作化框架，以应对这一挑战。
tldr: 本文证明预测侧认证（如准确性、校准和覆盖率）无法保证模型可信度，因为可靠与受损模型在这些指标下可完全一致但在解释和部署上不同，需结合决策机制和“能力包络”框架来增强认证。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that prediction-side certificates (accuracy, calibration, coverage) cannot ensure model trustworthiness, as reliable and compromised models can be identical under these metrics yet differ in explanation and deployment, necessitating access to decision mechanisms and the "competence envelope" framework.
